tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta mgrin snying thig snying po don sbyor gyi phrin las byang bu khyer bder bsdus pa dbang chen dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang rta mchog dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// e yig stong chen rdo rje btsun mo'i mkhar// waṃ yig gtum chen dpa' bo'i bde gar gyis// grub gnyis bdud rtsi ci yang 'jo ba'i dpyid// snying dbus rtag par rol la rjes brtser mdzod// dkon cing rin thang che ba'i dbyig /yid bzhin nor bu dang mtshungs pa// legs byas zongs su khug 'dir yang*// legs bshad byi dor cung zad spel// rta mchog dbang gi sgrub thabs bye ba phrag brgya'i yang bcud rta mgrin snying po don sbyor gyi phrin las khyer bder bkod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rten dang gtor ma phyi nang gi mchod pa tshogs kyi yo byad dang nye bar mkho ba rnams 'du bya/ de la/ sngon gtor bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod srung*// skyabs sems tshogs gsag mchod brlab brgyad// ces pa ltar las dang po sngon gtor ni/ dkar gtor dang bgegs gtor glud gzugs changs bu ting lo mtheb skyu sha dum dang bcas pa bshams la/ dkar gtor/ swa bhā ba 'i sngags kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha mi'i zhal zas: kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa: bde ba khyad par can skyed pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur: a kā ro 'i sngags lan gsum dang mtshan bzhi brjod pas byin brlab/ sambha ra 'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas: phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas: sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang: sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang: sa dang lam la gnas pa dang: de bzhin dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phyir: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la: bdag la bar chad ma mdzad par: bdag gi dge ba'i sdongs grogs mdzod: gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag sogs:

lha klu dkar phyogs skyong rnams mchod: zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi: las kyi dngos grub sogs phrin las spyi ltar bcol la gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul/ bgegs gtor byin rlabs gong ltar bya/ hrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ kaṃ ka /rang nyid dpal rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyus bgegs rnams bkug par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa bkug / sambha ra 'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsngo// gnyis pa bka' bsgo zhing bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'du ba'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa'i: gsang ba'i dam can so so nas: mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs: rgyud drug gnas pa'i sems can rnams: sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyin gtor gyis: khyod kyis re ba bskangs zin gyis: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni: tho ba lcags kyu zhags pa dang: ral gri mtshon cha mang po yis: khyod kyi lus srog ma lus kun: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed: de bas 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: phaṭa na maḥs manta kā ya wā ka tsittā nāṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ces bgegs gtor phyir dor/ gsum pa mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: ye shes rol pa dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: gdod nas rnam dag chos nyid yangs pa'i klong: bgegs dang log 'dren bya ba'i ming yang med: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal rta mchog dpal: che ba'i lha rnams nga yi 'khor: dregs pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: phyogs bcur sprul pa'i khro bo 'gyed: hūm̐ mdzad rnam rgyal dbyug sngon can: gshin rje mi g.yo rta mchog dpal: 'dod rgyal 'khyil pa khams gsum rgyal: stobs chen 'jigs byed khro rgyal rnams: steng 'og phyogs mtshams sgo srung dus la bab: sgo ba rnams kyis sgo srungs la: mtshams ma rnams kyis mtshams chod cig:

srung dang mtshams kyi phrin las mdzod: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra ma hā kro ta ha ya grī ba badzra bā ra hī ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐: bi dza ya hūm̐: nī la daṇḍa hūm̐: ya mānta ka hūm̐: ārya a tsa la hūm̐: ha ya grī ba hūm̐: a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐: a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐: trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: ma hā ba la hūm̐: gnod byed thams cad gardza gardza: ha na ha na: da ha da ha: pa tsa pa tsa: bhandha bhandha: hu lu hu lu: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha: tshindha tshindha: bhindha bhindha: spho ṭa spho ṭa: mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gnod byed thams cad sarba bighnān gatstsha: bzhi pa srung 'khor ni/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje yi// sa gzhi ra gur phub pa'i phyir// mtshon cha sna tshogs me phung 'bar// nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu nag /khro bcu nag po mda' gzhu 'gengs// zlog pa'i las mdzad zhal phyir gzigs// de nang 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dmar// srung ba'i las mdzad khro bo bcu// dmar po ral gri tsakra bsnams// nang du gzigs pa'i gur nang du// dur khrod gzhal yas mtshan rdzogs dbus// dregs pa nyi zla padma'i steng*// bdag nyid dpal chen rta mgrin dmar/ khros ma nag mo yum dang sbyor// dur khrod chas gsol gri thod bsnams// bde chen rab 'bar me klong bzhugs// spyi bor pad 'byung yab yum dang*// 'khor du sprul pa'i khro tshogs bskor// thugs kar nyi steng 'bar ba'i hrīḥ ra btags nang du bsrung bya pho// hūm̐ sngon mo rnams ma yig ni// ljang sngon rnam pas gnas par gyur// ha ya grī ba hrīḥgab: padmānta kṛta hrīḥgab: padma bhandha hrīḥgab: tsin dha rag sha hrīḥgab: ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: ma ma rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: e ā ralli hrīng hrīng dza: ma ma rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ badzra kro ta ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐:

oṃ badzra bā ra hī kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐: oṃ shrī kro tī kā li hūm̐ phaṭa: ma ma rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐: lnga pa skyabs 'gro ni/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar: rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ drug pa sems bskyed ni/ shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas: brtson pas sems can don du bdag: sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya'o: lan gsum/ bdun pa tshogs gsag ni/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang: he ru ka dpal phag mor bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus rnams: bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol: sku gsum lhun grub yi dam lha: bla med gsum la skyabs su mchi: lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ni: gus pa'i sgo nas bdag phyag 'tshal: bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin la: phyi nang gsang ba'i rol pas mchod: sdig pa'i phyogs rnams ci mchis pa: de dag thams cad so sor bshags: gang gis dus gsum bsags pa yi: dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rang: sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa rnams: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams: byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi: mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: bde ba'i ngang du rgyal gyur cig: brgyad pa phyi nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ zhu ba las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du: oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon: me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas sgra snyan thams cad kyis sa dang nam mkha' dang bar snang thams cad yongs su gang ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa: kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa:

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad cing rgyas par gyur cig: oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐: puṣpe nas shabda 'i bar du sbyar/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzriṃ oṃ khaṃ: nṛ dha ku gho dha las bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga: de'i steng nyi zla padma'i gdan la rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon bcu gsal: spha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rlung g.yos: me sbar: thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhu: yi ge bcu las 'od zer 'phro 'dus phyag mtshan bcur gyur: spha ra ṇa phaṭa: de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus rigs lnga yab yum bcur gyur: ma sūrya maṇḍa la hūm̐: badzra oṃ: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: e oṃ sa ma ya ho: a nu rā ga yā mi: a nu rā ga ya ho: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya: mu dra pra be sha ya phaṭa: oṃ oṃ oṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: spha ra ṇa phaṭa: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas: dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur par bsam la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum brjod pas/ zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir 'khyil pas: rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi la thim par bsam: oṃ bi shuddhe a mṛta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod cing gtor bas/ phyi snod 'jig rten gzhal yas khang: nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam: oṃ dharma a mṛta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod cing gtor pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam nyid spros bral du bsam: badzra yakṣa kro ta a mṛta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brjod cing gtor bas/ bdud rtsi'i thigs pa re re la yang:

khro chung mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pas: bgegs thams cad bskrad nas slar 'dus srung ba'i gur khang du gyur: padma dha ra hrī: bdud rtsi'i steng du zla dkyil la rta mgrin dbyug to sdigs mdzub can brkyang bskum du bzhengs pas bsrung bar gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las thod pa'i nang du ra yig las 'od 'phros 'byung ba khrag gi bcud thams cad bsdus nas thim te yongs su gyur pa las: rdo rje sgeg mo dmar mor gyur: de'i gsang ba nas khrag gi rgyun babs pas 'dod chags bcom pa'i rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: gsum/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i kha chod zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa: spha ra ṇa phaṭa: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros: rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol: 'bru gsum dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi bkug: dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ya swā hā: gsum/ zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil ba las: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i phung po mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa 'phro bas rgyal ba rnams mchod par gyur: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol: zhes brjod cing rol mo bya'o// dngos gzhi bdag dang dkyil 'khor bskyed// spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dbang bskur phyag /mchod bstod bzlas pa gtor 'bul bcu/

zhes pa ltar las dang po bdag bskyed rta phag lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ: mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku de bzhin nyid: ā: kun snang kun khyab 'gro la snying rje bsgom: hūm̐: stong nyid snying rje dbyer med phrin las kyi: hrī: thabs shes rtog med bam gyi steng: skad cig rang nyid rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal: padma rā ga'i mdog ltar sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis brkyang bskum bgrad: ral pa kham nag gyen brdzes spyi bo'i gtsug: rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma le brgan sprug: drag po'i rta skad khams gsum dbang du sdud: spyan bgrad ljags 'dril mche gtsigs hūm̐ sgra sgrog: rdo rje dril bu phyag na bsnams: 'gying zhing sku che yan lag rags pa la: dpal dang dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: 'jigs byed gtum drag dbang gi cha lugs can: sna tshogs thabs ldan 'bar ba'i gar dgur rol: g.yon na rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum: sku mdog mthing gsal 'od zer rab tu 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis yab la 'khril zhing sbyor: spyi gtsug phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrog: gcer bu spyan gsum mche gtsigs dbu skra grol: bcu drug lang tsho bha ga nu ma rgyas: phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas dung dmar stob cing kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: rus rgyan me long dril bu'i rgyan cha 'khrol: 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: ye shes rdo rje me 'bar gur khang bzhugs: de steng spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i steng: bla ma kun bzang che mchog he ru ka: rdo rje dril bu gnyis med yum dang sbyor: kun tu bzang mo khro mo gnam zhal ma: rdo rje thod khrag bsnams nas yab la 'khril: gcer bu gzi mdangs bde bas gang ba'i sku: nam mkha'i mdog can sgeg bzhad mnyen lcug can: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'phro: rin chen rus rgyan cod pan du mas mdzes: tsitta'i nang na zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis:

dung 'khyil nang na 'bar ba lnga bcu brgyad: bdag nyid thugs la dpa' bo yab yum lnga: grangs can grangs med gtso 'khor tshul du gnas: ye nas rang yin 'dzin med rang gsal gdab: bla ma rang rig rang gsal kun tu bzang: bde chen rnam dag spros bral kun bzang mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med mnyam nyid chos kyi sku: 'gyur med thag chod dpa' bo shes rab ma: rang byung rang shar cir yang ston cing sprul: lhun grub 'du 'bral med pa a la la: snang srid rnam dag dkyil 'khor rang lus rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ: hrīḥm ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdza: tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor sogs la 'di nas spyan 'dren la 'jug pas chog cing*/ sgrub pa dang dbang bskur sogs la mdun bskyed dang 'brel dgos pas/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ chos rnams ka dag 'od gsal stong nyid ngang*// mdun mkhar skad cig dbang chen yab yum gsal// thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad bkug /zhal zhugs 'od zhu yum gyi bha gar babs// de las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs// e yaṃ raṃ dang ra suṃ kiṃ bhrūm̐ chad// nam mkha' rlung me khrag mtsho zhing chen sa// rus pa'i ri steng dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// phyi ni rin chen nang rol thod pa'i mkhar// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs rim bzhin mdzes// drag po'i rgyan bkod mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs// dur khrod brgyad dang rdor ra me ris bskor// de dbus padma 'dab brgyad mu khyud bcas// dbus su paṃ las padma a las zla// raṃ las nyi steng ā li dkar po g.yas// kā li dmar po g.yon skor bar du hrīḥ dmar po gcig 'dres rdo rje rtse dgur gyur// de las 'od zer sa bon rnam pa ni/ kha dog sna tshogs phyogs mtshams brgyad du babs// skad cig gdod nas grub pa'i lhar gsal ba// gtso mchog rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa// rab dmar ye shes 'od 'phro 'gying bag ldan// g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar bzhad brjid khro// dmar ser dbu skra gyen brdzes spyan dgu bgrad// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rngog ma dmar// de steng rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas mtshan// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs smar smin me ltar 'bar// snyan gong utpal nyi ma zla bas brgyan// phyag drug dang pos rdo rje dril bu bsnol// bar pa gnyis kyis kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag gdengs// tha mas rgyu zhags dang ni lcags sgrog 'dzin/

sbrul rigs lnga dang thod pa skam rlon phreng*// glang ko zhing lpags stag sham dar sna 'phur// thal raka zhag gis spras shing gar dgur ldan// dbu skra ba spu khro chung tshwa tshwa 'phro// zhabs bzhi 'dor thabs me phung dbus su bzhugs// gnas gsum 'khor lo padma rgya gram lter// rnam snang mtha' yas rdor sems thugs ka ru// rdo rje gsum dngos yi ge gsum gyis mtshan// tsitta rin chen zur brgyad nyi zla'i steng*// ye shes sems dpa' dung mdog rdor dril 'dzin// thugs kar zla steng rdo rje rtse lnga'i lter// nyi steng hūm̐ sngon sngags kyi phreng bas bskor// yum mchog phag mo mthing nag khro mo'i tshul// spyi gtsug phag zhal mthing nag ngur sgra sgrog /gri gug yab 'khyud thod khrag zhal du stob// thod sbrul phyag rgya lngas brgyan dur khrod kyi// chas rdzogs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang yab la sbyor// snang stong thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa// bde stong zung 'jug kha sbyor sku ru gsal// phyogs mtshams padma nyi steng khrag 'thung brgyad// shar du rdo rje dbang chen nam mkha'i mdog /yum mchog rdo rje dbang phyug dkar gsal 'khril// lho ru rin chen dbang chen gser gyi mdog /yum mchog rin chen dbang phyug dmar gsal 'khril// nub tu padma dbang chen rā ga'i mdog /yum mchog padma dbang phyug mthing gsal 'khril// byang du las kyi dbang chen margad mdog /yum mchog las kyi dbang phyug ser gsal 'khril// kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad// g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon pas thod khrag dang*// yum rnams g.yas g.yon kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag bsnams// shar lhor sku mchog dpa' bo he ru ka /dkar po rdo rje ḍā ki dkar ser 'khril// lho nub yon tan dpa' bo he ru ka /ser po ratna ḍā ki ser dmar 'khril// nub byang gsung mchog dpa' bo he ru ka /dmar po padma ḍā ki dmar ljang 'khril// byang shar phrin las dpa' bo he ru ka

/ljang gu karma ḍā ki ljang dkar 'khril// yab rnams g.yas pa rang rtags g.yon dril bu// yum rnams rang rtags mtshan pa'i gri thod bsnams// yab yum brgyad ka cha lugs gtso dang mthun// dbu gtsug rta zhal 'tsher zhing phag zhal ngur// bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs// sgo bzhir dregs pa nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng*/ khwa gdong mthing ga rtse gsum lcags kyu thogs// phag gdong ser mo thod dbyug zhags pa 'chang*/ khyi gdong dmar mo zhing dbyug lcags sgrog bsnams// 'ug gdong ljang gu ral gri dril bu 'dzin// mtshams bzhir padma nyi steng khro mo bzhi// phyogs mdog phyed gzugs rang rtags gri thod 'dzin// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan ldan brkyang bskum gar// 'gying bag ye shes rang 'od 'bar bar gsal// oṃ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: hrīḥm ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa:

ces brjod pas/ bskyed pa'i lha tshogs de dag thams cad sngar bas sku che la gzi brjid bkrag mdangs dang ldan par gyur: gsum pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dbang chen gyi lha ye shes pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bya rgod thed la lding ba bzhin chi li li 'byon par bsam zhing*/ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bsdu ba'i rgya dang*/ rol mo/ sbyar spos/ dbyangs kyi 'gyur bag dang bcas te/ hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol byed pa mi rigs kyang: 'gro ba'i blo yi dbul ba bsal ba'i phyir: phrin las myur mgyogs thogs med 'bar ba'i sku: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: o rgyan bde chen bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bla ma kun bzang che mchog he ru ka: padma 'byung gnas yab yum gshegs su gsol: dbang chen me rlung 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: gar gyi dbang phyug padma dbang chen sku: khro rgyal rta mchog yab yum gshegs su gsol: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: snang srid 'khor 'das ma rgyud yongs kyi gtso: yum mchog rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol: thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sprul pa'i khro tshogs yab yum gshegs su gsol: keng rus gsar rnying 'khrol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dam can srung ma yab yum gshegs su gsol: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: ma hā kā la yab yum gshegs su gsol: 'khor dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs: rdzu 'phrul du ma ston phyir gshegs su gsol: bdag la bsam pa'i bu slob la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: sdang dgra gnod bgegs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: ru dra pho mo 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol:

rgyal bsen pho mo 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: padma shrī he ru ka sarba duṣṭān ta ka ha na da ha hrīḥhrī: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrī: ru dra bsgral ba'i khrag gi klong rum na: lhun grub bde chen pho brang 'bar ba'i dbus: thabs shes nyi zla padma'i gdan khri la: byin rlabs mchog stsol o rgyan gu ru rje: 'jigs byed dpal chen padma he ru ka: 'khor gyi khro chen dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: bar chad gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: yab yum sras 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi don slad du: gnyis med tshul gyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol: padma shrī he ru ka sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa dbang bskur ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ: zhes gsol ba btab pas: gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo spyan ma sogs bzhi pos kyang: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa rnams yo ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye hūm̐: zhes bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dpag tu med pa brjod cing dbang bskur: bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i brda mdzad: khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad par bsam: ye shes chus lus thams cad gang: dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag: chu yi lhag ma rnams yar lud pa las: lha thams cad la rigs rnam pa lngas dbu brgyan par gyur: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras: padma 'byung gnas yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: che btsan dpe med khams gsum rgyal por grags: khro rgyal dbang chen yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes 'od zer nam mkha'i skar ltar gsal:

thugs rje chen po dbyings phyug che la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje chen pos dbyings nas sprul pa 'gyed: sprul pa'i khro tshogs bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: a la la ho: bdun pa mchod pa rnams kyi thog mar bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ hrī: rang byung gdod nas dag pa ste: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol zhing: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: byin rlabs mchog stsol bla ma yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: dbang chen khro rgyal yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: rigs bzhi'i he ru ka dpal yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: thabs shes dbang sgyur dpa' bo dpa' mo la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku rta mchog dpal: tshangs pa'i 'brug sgras khams gsum dbang du sdud: mi rtog mi dmigs mnyam nyid chos kyi sku: bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: kā ya siddhi oṃ: wā ka siddhi ā: tsitta siddhi hūm̐: de nas phyi nang gsang gsum de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul: dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul: snang gsal mar me spyan la 'bul: yid 'ong byug mchog sku la 'bul: rol mo sna tshogs snyan la 'bul: ro mchog brgya ldan ljags la 'bul: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa 'di: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po lnga yi me tog mchod: gsur chen bdug spos dri yis mchod: zhun chen snang gsal mar mes mchod: rdo rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod: rdo rje dri chen zhal zas mchod: rkang gling dril bu thod rngas mchod: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod: ye shes lnga yi mchod pa 'di: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang nas: 'khril sbyor byang chub sems kyis mchod: bde ba'i ro myong mchod par bzhes: ye shes sku mchog bde ba skyed pa'i phyir: byang sems dkar dmar thabs shes bdud rtsi'i bcud: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs la: de kho na nyid mchod pa 'bul ba ni: chos dbyings 'od gsal rab 'byams nam mkha' che: dbyings rig 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: bkra shis lhun grub sku dang thig les brgyan: lhan skyes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang: ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag: rnam dag chen po mchog gi mchod pa 'di: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ gu ru padma ha ya grī ba dhā ki nī arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe

nai bidyā shabda swā hā: māṃ sa tsitta kiṃ ni ri ti go ro tsa na ba su ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba ni/ oṃ: mtshan ldan snod du ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sbyar ba'i sman: lhun grub bde chen bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod 'bul: oṃ: dung chen snod du dmar chen rba rlabs 'khrugs: ā: bde chen ye shes rakta ba gam 'khrigs: hūm̐: rten 'brel bcu gnyis rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: hrī: rang byung rnam dag rakta'i mchod pa bzhes: oṃ: phyi snod 'jig rten bhandha ru: ā: nyon mongs dug chen 'gro ba rab bsgral te: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag bcud chen gtor mar sbyar: hrī: rmad byung dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: rgyas par spro na/ byin rlabs mchog stsol bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ma hā pañtsa sogs gong bzhin sbyar la 'bul lo// brgyad pa bstod pa ni/ hrī: ma bcos spros bral 'gyur ba med pa la: pad sdong las byung skye 'chi med pa'i sku: yab yum gnyis med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: gu ru padma yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul khro bo'i skur ston pa: 'gro don mdzad pa'i bcom ldan dbang chen sku: chags tshul 'gro don sku mdog dmar por bstan: gcer bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mnga' ba: nyon mongs rtsad gcod mdzad pa'i stobs po che: sna tshogs 'gro ba'i don mdzad sprul pa'i sku: phyag mtshan sna tshogs nyon mongs dbyings su sgrol: bde chen dpa' bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdzu 'phrul thogs med sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed: dur khrod chas kyis dpa' bo dbang du sdud: spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur mig 'bras mthing nag zlog: rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog cing mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud:

ye shes rol pa'i sku mchog he ru ka: ye shes me yis ma rig mun pa sreg: 'dor thabs zhabs kyis bdud bzhi ma lus gzir: skye med rnam dag ye shes sku mnga' ba: ye shes dpa' bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: rdo rje phag mo bder gshegs yum: 'dod pa'i dbang phyug skal ldan ma: mkha' 'gro chen mo rnal 'byor gtso: 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: khro mo chen mo dbang sgyur phag gdong ma: nam mkha'i mdog can rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: rgyal ba kun gyi yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar gtso la stobs: bdud dpung ma lus 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: rab khros am gtsigs mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum sdang mig gzir zhing dgra bgegs bskrad: dpa' mo he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal can: drag po'i chas brgyad sku la rab tu rdzogs: bdud 'joms drag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: smin ma dmar ser bskal pa'i glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra kham ser ral pa gyen la brdzes: dbang sgyur phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bde gshegs rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku: 'gyur ba med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: mi zad pa yi gter dang ldan: yid bzhin nor bu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: padma rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: chags pa la sogs skyon dang bral: dri med ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: las kyi rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: bdag gzhan don rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam tshig rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: ye srung chen po'i ngo bo ste: skyon med rnam dag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jig rten rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: chos mdzad bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i:

thogs med rdzu 'phrul sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: thams cad ma lus dpa' bo yab yum ni: gang 'tsham phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: phyogs med yon tan sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sha za rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum ni: mi srun drag mo'i cha byad can: dam nyams srog gcod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: phrin las sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: don dam dbyings las 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul shar: sna tshogs gar byed bskal pa'i glog ltar 'khyug: thugs rje'i zhal phyag rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab: 'khor gyi bka' nyan yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs: chos kyi dbyings las snang srid chos skur ston: thams cad du ma ro gcig ngang la phyag 'tshal bstod: rta mchog khyod la bdag gis gus bstod na: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol ba dang: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba dang: gnod pa'i 'byung po ma lus 'dul ba dang: dngos grub chen po dus 'dir bstsal du gsol: dgu pa dzap bsnyen bzla ba ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar padma 'dab bzhi ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i dkyil du yab la hrīḥdamar po ra tsa hri yas g.yas su bskor ba/ yum la ma mthing nag ha ri ni sas g.yon du bskor ba/ bzlas pa tsam gyis yig 'bru rnams g.yas g.yon du drag tu 'khor zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gtso 'khor thams cad kyis sngags kyi sgra 'ur 'ur dir dir sgrog par gyur/ ces mos la/ hrīḥm ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa tsitta hrīng hrīng dzaḥdza: zhes mi sdod pa gsum gyi gnad bskul nas bzla'o// bcu pa thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma sha chang bza' bcas brgyan pa bshams la/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga zla ba'i kha chod byas pa'i steng du kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse mo thur bstan 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/

spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos/ me spar/ thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ ma dag pa'i nyes skyon phyir lud de 'dod yon lnga'i lbu ba chi li li phyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ rlangs pa 'od zer gyi tshul du yar 'phros pas rgyal ba yab yum rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka dang sbyor mtshams nas ā li kā li dkar dmar gyi rnam pa byon nas zla ba'i kha chod la thim/ rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ gas dkrugs pas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hāḥ lan mang du brjod/ gtor mgron spyan drang ba ni 'bar ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ e ā ralli ho: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba ra tsa hri ya badzra bā ra hī dhā ki nī ha ri nī sa: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: dṛ shya ho: pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ: mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang gi lha tshogs rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon nas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdza: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

gsum/ oṃ badzra kro ta hya grī ba ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ sogs gsum/ oṃ shrī badzra bā ra hī kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul ba'i rjes su/ ma hā māṃ sa: ma hā rakta: ma hā tsitta: ma hā go ro tsa na: ma hā ba su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bha su raṃ: gṛhṇa pra tītstsha ho: khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: zhes brjod pas gtor mgron rnams mnyes par bsam ste/ thod rnga dang dril bu 'khrol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni 'di skad do// hrī: rang bzhin gnas mchog 'og min dam pa nas: bcom ldan rta mchog yab yum 'khor bcas dang: dam can pho mo gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i rkyen la sogs: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa rnams: bstab bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstab: 'bul lo mkha' 'gro'i mgron la 'bul: bstan srung drag po'i phrin las mdzod: bdag cag rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog nor spel cig: bshad sgrub bstan pa dar bar mdzod: ces 'bul zhing phrin las bcol lo// rjes la tshogs mchod chad brtan bro// mchod bstod nongs bshags gshegs bsdu dang*// bsngo smon shis pa brjod pa brgyad// ces pa ltar las/ dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ ba la dang māṃ sa ma da na gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa bshams la bdud rtsi 'thor te byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hrī: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge spro: raṃ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsreg: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: hrī: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin gyis rlob pa'i yi ge 'phros: oṃ gyis skye med dbyings su spel: āḥyis 'gag med longs skur spel:

hūm̐ gis blo 'das chos skur spel: hrīḥyis zag med bdud rtsir bsgyur: swā yis 'dzad med bcud du bsgyur: hā yis ro mchog brgya dang ldan: hrī: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor spel ba'i yi ge spro: oṃ gyis ye shes bde ba chen por sbyangs: āḥyis thabs shes gnyis med bcud du bsgyur: hūm̐ gis bla na med pa'i bcud du spel: hrīḥyis thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur spro: swā yis dpa' bo bzhi dang ldan par sbyar: hā yis yi dam lha tshogs dgyes shing skong bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī:swā hā: zhes mang du brjod/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrī: byin rlabs mchog stsol gu ru yab yum ni: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku: chos kyi sku las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hrī: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mchog yab yum ni: chos dbyings ye shes 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: chos kyi sku las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hrī: dbang chen khro rgyal rigs bzhi yab yum ni: ye shes rnam bzhi 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: chos kyi sku las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hrī: dbang chen sprul pa'i sgo mtshams khro mo brgyad: dkar ser dmar ljang 'od zer rab tu 'bar: chos kyi sku las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hrī: bstan pa srung mdzad mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: drag po'i las mdzad gtum drag 'bar ba'i sku: chos kyi sku las sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs la: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: a la la ho: de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa g.yas su sha /g.yon du chang*/ dbus su zan/

gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag rnams btegs/ byin rlabs ma byas pa'i gser skyems shig kyang bshams la/ hrī: thod snod bandha 'bar ba'i tshogs gzhong 'di: rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang rab tu mnyam: thabs mchog māṃ sa shes rab bdud rtsi dang: ba liṃ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: zab cing rgya che bcud ldan rab tu dwangs: 'chi med mchog gi bdud rtsi chen por 'bul: hrī: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs te: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi: bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hrī: yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la sogs te: dngos grub ma lus stsol mdzad pa'i: yi dam rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hrī: dbang chen rta mchog la sogs pa'i: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa: yang gsang khro bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hrī: rdo rje phag mo la sogs te: dag snang bde chen spor mdzad pa'i: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hrī: ye shes mgon po la sogs te: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad pa: phyi nang chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hrī: dbyings phyug lha mo la sogs te: rnal 'byor bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: hrī: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong la sogs te: bdud dang bstan pa'i ru dra 'dul mdzad pa: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: snang srid bde chen tshogs mchod 'di: dgyes pa chen por da rol cig: bde chen longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa rnams: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du sgrims shig ā ralli: gnyis su med par 'bul lags na:

bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol: ga ṇa tsakra la kha raṃ khā hi: bdud rtsi 'thor la/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa 'di rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas skyabs 'og dam par chud par mdzad du gsol/ dbang chen rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub bstsal du gsol lo// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho/ las kyi ma mo sngags srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// bzhes nas phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod cig / gser skyems 'thor la/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis gsang sngags kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ yul ris sa phyogs 'di nyid du gnas pa'i dkar phyogs skyong ba dam tshig can rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ chos dang mthun pa'i sdongs grogs rgya chen po mdzod cig / de nas tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba ni/ hrī: dpal chen yab yum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dug gsum dam rdzas tshogs su sbyar ba yi: sbyor dang sgrol ba'i bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod 'di: 'dod dgur 'bul lo bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi: bar pas bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hrī: byin rlabs mchog stsol bla ma yab yum thugs dam bskang: dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: 'dod dgu 'byung 'gyur ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: phrin las myur mdzad bka' srung chos skyong thugs dam bskang: khyed kyi thugs dam gnyan po bdag gis bskang: bdag gi cho ga lhag chad khyed kyis bskang: g.yar dam bskangs la rkyen dbang zlog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hrī: dpal chen yab yum 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol:

ma rig bdag gi lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: khro tshogs yab yum thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes pa dang yi ge brgya pas bshags par bya'o// tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ tshogs zan nam nya bo la 'gugs gzhug bya/ nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: bdag ni dbang drag padma he ru ka: phyag g.yas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu phyogs bcur gdengs: g.yon pas sgrol ba'i phur bus dgra snying gzir: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar chad byed pa'i dam sri 'byung po rnams: rdul du rlogs la dbyings su da sgrol cig: ru dra dug lnga'i lnga phung rtsad nas chod: dgra bgegs dam sri sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: ces bsgral la/ hrī: dbang gi rgyal po rngam chen 'jigs pa'i sku: sprul pa'i khro rgyal mang po'i tshogs dang bcas: sku ni rngam brjid zhal ni khro gnyer ldan: rngams pa'i mche gtsigs drag po'i ljags rkyongs la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig zhal du kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā tsitta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: zhes bstab/ de nas brda'i 'bul len spyi ltar byas la rdo rje slob dpon nas brtsam ste rim par drang*/ nang gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas rol/ lhag ma gsog 'jog med par bsdus te zhal chab bdud rtsis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa bhakṣa si swā hā: zhes byin brlabs la/ hrī: sngon tshe bcom ldan khrag 'thung spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang: ci ltar bcol ba'i las rnams sgrub par mdzod: utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes phyi rol du 'bul lo// gnyis pa chad mdo ni/

hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang na: slob dpon chen po kun bzang yab yum dang: slob ma rig rtsal sems dpa'i tshogs bcas kyis: stong gsal gnyis med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: sgrib med klong gsal ḍā ki 'khor bcas kyis: thugs rjes sprul pa'i rang gzugs bstan nas kyang: cir snang gtor ma len par ma chad dam: 'gyur med bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: gnyis snang dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: dag pa gnyis ldan gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: de 'og bar gyi bskal pa'i dbus ma la: ting 'dzin lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang du: slob dpon chen po rdo rje 'chang chen dang: slob ma rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpa' yis: lhun grub rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rigs lnga dam tshig ḍā ki 'khor bcas kyis: sprul pa rang snang yid gzugs bstan nas kyang: cir snang gtor ma len par ma chad dam: 'gyur med bstan pa bsrung par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam: log lta'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: rnam dag rang byung gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i tha ma la: bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag tu: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang: slob ma rigs ldan rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyis: yang gsang rol pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dregs pa pho mo srog bdag 'khor bcas kyis: drag po rang snang yid gzugs bstan nas kyang: rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas ni: cir snang gtor ma len par ma chad dam: 'gyur med bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: rnal 'byor sku tshe bsring bar ma chad dam:

log lta'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: dam tshig bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi zhal zhes dam la ma 'da' bar: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: da dus deng sang bskal pa'i snyigs ma la: skye rga na 'chi 'gyur ba'i pho brang du: brtson 'grus yengs med sngags 'chang bdag nyid kyis: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyis: rang rtags srog gi snying po phul nas ni: cir snang gtor ma len par ma chad dam: 'gyur med bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma chad dam: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam la ma 'da' bar: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: gsum pa bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bhyo: dpal chen yab yum bka' nyan pa: shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig: lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig: nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun: drug ni ye shes byings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: padma rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig: byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun: drug ni ye shes dbyings na bzhugs: gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad: las kyi rigs kyi ḍā ki bdun: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig: lang ka dur khrod bdag mo dang: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar brgyad drug cu bzhi:

bshes gnyen rlangs dang padma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas bka' yi gtor ma longs: zhi rgyas dbang drag 'gugs bsgral mnan gzir sogs: bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus grub par mdzod: bzhi pa gtor bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bro brdung bdud bzhi 'dul: ma mo'i bro brdung gdug pa 'dul: dbang gi bro brdung srin po 'dul: las kyi bro brdung pho nya 'gyed: rnal 'byor bro brdung thugs dam bskul: 'di ni dpal gyi thugs dam yin: 'di ni yum gyi gsang tshig yin: 'di ni ma sring dngos grub yin: 'di ni pho nya'i longs spyod yin: 'di ni rnal 'byor lta ba'i bro: de phyir glu 'di rgyun ma bcad: de phyir bro 'di rtag tu brdung: dgra ni thal bar brlag pa'i bro: bdud ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro: rgyud drug gnas nas gcod pa'i bro: rdul du rlogs shig dgra dang bgegs: 'phang ngo rgya mtsho'i gting du 'phang: 'khor skyon chu srin kha ru bor: oṃ sumbha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags mthar/ st+wambha rakṣa nan: lnga pa mchod bstod nongs bshags ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ gu ru padma ha ya grī ba dhā ki nī badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: māṃ sa tsitta kiṃ ni ri ti go ro tsa na ba su ta kha raṃ khā hi: sarba pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi sras: padma 'byung gnas yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: che btsan dpe med khams gsum rgyal por grags: khro rgyal dbang chen yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ye shes 'od zer nam mkha'i skar ltar gsal: thugs rje chen po dbyings phyug che la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje chen pos dbyings nas sprul pa 'gyed: sprul pa'i khro tshogs bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang

sogs dang yig brgya dbyangs gsal lan gsum brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ drug pa gshegs bsdu ni/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa dmigs med 'od gsal gyi dbyings su zhugs par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ slar yang rang nyid dbang chen 'bar ba'i skur shar ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pas bar chad las bsrung bar gyur/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ snang grags rig gsum ye shes kyi 'khor lor rnam par dag pa'o// bdun pa smon lam ni/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis: 'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te: srid na 'ga' yang mi gnas pa: thams cad sangs rgyas nyid thob shog: ces sogs brjod/ brgyad pa bkra shis ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje mngon du gyur: chos dbyings rnam dag klong la mnga' brnyes pa'i: bla ma yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: zhi ba'i gar sgyur bcom ldan sgeg pa'i dpa' bo ni: mi bskyod rdo rje me long ye shes ngang: 'gro ba'i lus la dbang sgyur rdo rje'i sku: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: rgyas pa'i gar sgyur bcom ldan sgeg pa'i dpa' bo ni: rin chen 'byung ldan mnyam nyid ye shes ngang: 'gro ba'i yon tan dbang sgyur yon tan mchog: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dbang gi gar sgyur bcom ldan sgeg pa'i dpa' bo ni: snang ba mtha' yas sor rtog ye shes ngang: 'gro ba'i ngag la dbang sgyur gsung gi mchog: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: chos kyi gar sgyur bcom ldan sgeg pa'i dpa' bo ni: rnam par snang mdzad chos dbyings ye shes ngang: 'gro ba'i yid la dbang sgyur thugs kyi mchog:

bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: phrin las gar sgyur bcom ldan sgeg pa'i dpa' bo ni: don yod grub pa bya grub ye shes ngang: 'gro ba'i las la dbang sgyur phrin las mchog: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo zhing skyong dang: tshogs brgyad dbang sgyur laṅka srung ma'i tshogs: bka' srung rgya mtsho rnams kyi bkra shis gang lags pa: bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ces brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// gzhung 'di la las byang rgyas pa rin chen phreng ba dang tshogs las rin chen dngos grub gnyis bzhugs kyang khyer bder ma mchis shing gter chos grags chung bas 'don bde'i chog bsgrigs sogs kyang mi bzhugs stabs/ zab chos 'di nyid 'phel rgyas su 'gyur ba'i sgor dmigs nas phrin las che chung gi bcud bsdus kyang so skye'i blo'i nongs pa gang mchis rtsa gsum chos srung dang bcas pa la bshags par bgyi bas bzod par mdzad du gsol lo// gter rnying rtog ge'i tshig gis ma bslad pa// don zab byin rlabs che yang deng dus kyi// gyer tshig sgros 'don mkhan dang mi mdza' bas/ khyer bde'i tshig don snying po bsdus pa yin// zab chos 'di yang mi nub dar zhing rgyas// rim gnyis rnal du 'byor bas ri sul khengs// grub pa'i 'bras bzang ro bda'i longs spyod kyis// yid can thar pa'i bcud mchog rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang rang nyid kyi 'dun pa'i sa bon la/ rnam 'dren dam pa byang chub chos kyi seng ge'i gsung gis bskul bas sad byed du byas te/ dpal spungs yang khrod dbang chen rol pa'i pho brang du padma gar gyi dbang phyug phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //
